description: Private markets from Form D, filed when startups and funds sell securities without registering: amount offered and sold, number of investors, minimum investment, exemption (Rule 506(b) or 506(c)), industry, fund type and the people behind it, for one issuer or across the market (newest first, filtered by industry or amount sold).

company.description: An issuer by name or CIK (a startup, a fund). Without it, the latest Form D filings across the market.

industry.description: Across the market, keep issuers whose Form D industry group contains these words: "Pooled Investment Fund", "Biotechnology", "Other Technology", "Real Estate", "Banking".

limit.description: Most offerings to list; default 20. Across the market at most 100 filings are read to find them.

min_sold.description: Across the market, keep offerings that have sold at least this many dollars.

since.description: Filed on or after this date; default seven days ago across the market, ten years for an issuer.

name: private_offerings

outputSchema.description: rows are Form D offerings, newest first, in the order of columns; sold and offered are dollars (offered may be indefinite).

title: Private offerings (Form D)
